senses.gloss: (b. h. עמם; √אם, עם to be pressed, dark; cmp. אֵם; חמם a. deriv.; v. אמיטתא)to grow dim, (in b. h. also to obscure, excel; v. infra).
units: Sabb. 77ᵇ; Ber. 53ᵇ; Pes. 75ᵇ גחלים אוֹמְמוֹת (or עוֹמְמוֹת) dying coals (question as to spelling decided in favor of ע by reference to Ezek. XXXI, 8 ‘the cedars did not obscure him, i.e. excel his beauty).
